name: Fetch MCP Server
description: HTTP tool — fetch web pages and API responses (GET by default; optional method gated by allow_unsafe_methods)

config_schema.label: Allow Unsafe Methods
config_schema.description: When false (default), the fetch tool only allows safe/read-only HTTP methods (GET, HEAD, OPTIONS). When true, all HTTP methods (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, etc.) are allowed. Configure per-plugin via the config endpoint (POST /api/plugins/tools/bundled/fetch/config with {"config":{"allow_unsafe_methods":"true"}}) or the plugins.yml `config:` map. The value reaches the plugin subprocess as the env var `allow_unsafe_methods`.
